reader.reads: Every place in German and each thesis against it; scan pages 6, 7, 13 and 78, including the enlarged line on page 7.

rudolf-otto.das-heilige:numinous-categor.note: The second sentence says the category and disposition in both theses. The cut opens with ‘dieses Moment in seiner Vereinzelung’, whose referent requires the preceding discussion of the distinctive element of the holy; the formula does not include it.

images.note: The enlarged line reads ‘hierfür zunächst das Wort: das Numinöse, (wenn man von’ and the following line ‘omen ominös bilden kann, dann auch von numen numinös),’.

summary: The theses on fear and the sublime stand, and the pages read as the packet. The first formula opens with an unresolved reference to the preceding discussion, although its second sentence bears the thesis.
